Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent game depth-layer sprites with real transparency.
Expand the same approved Underworld pixel metroidvania. Reference 1 defines unified handcraft and atmospheric hierarchy, reference 2 defines material sprites. Fine crisp pixel clusters, subdued material colors, limited edge highlights, very quiet shadow mass. No chunky outline, no noisy speckles, no painterly blur.
Sheet: wide 1536x1024 canvas, EXACTLY 4 ROWS × 2 equal-width COLUMNS, 8 isolated horizontal scenery islands total. Each object fully contained inside its cell with generous transparent gutters. Left column is a MIDGROUND distant low scenery grouping (wide:height ~2.4:1). Right column is a LOWER NEAR FOREGROUND clump (wide:height ~3:1). Both columns equally wide. No tall wall strips or upright rectangular edge panels. No background plate, no floor rectangle, no continuous slab across the cells. Natural outer boundary all around each independent clump: tapered irregular left/right tips, silhouette tips at top, irregular rock/root/debris underside. Absolutely NO flat horizontal cut across top or vertical cropped end. Objects will be placed around gameplay platform height, NOT around the whole screen borders.
ROW 1: Windchime Plains; materials wind-worn bluegray limestone, sage grass, subdued warm brass and ivory.
LEFT midground: asymmetric sage meadow outcrop with three distant thin bell-marker stakes, tiny leaning grasses.
RIGHT near foreground: low spreading wind-swept grasses rooted among three bluegray worn rocks, one tiny weathered bell shard.
ROW 2: Thorn Forest; materials dark brown fine bark, subdued olive moss, bluegreen shade, small faded ochre accents.
LEFT midground: horizontal exposed root bank with three staggered slim broken trunks and distant olive ferns, no arch.
RIGHT near foreground: low sprawling thorn root tangle with fern tips and a hollow stump undergrowth, tapering natural ends.
ROW 3: Mushroom Caverns; materials muted mauve slate, turquoise cyan fungal tips, violet beige cap interiors.
LEFT midground: low purple rock island with layered tall and short mauve mushrooms, tiny subdued blue cap edges.
RIGHT near foreground: low overlapping dark mauve shelf fungi and two jagged purple stones, sparse cyan gill tips.
ROW 4: Firefly Marsh; materials quiet brown peat, olive reeds, desaturated bluegreen water stains and tiny yellowgreen tips.
LEFT midground: wide low reed island with one crooked stake and distant cattail silhouettes, no water rectangle.
RIGHT near foreground: spreading dark reeds and a shallow peat root clump, cattails leaning in wind, naturally tapered ends.
Near foreground shapes should be dark and low, but show reference material colors when examined, not solid black. Midground about one value step lighter, no haze baked outside the silhouette. Keep visually coherent tiny material clusters at final native widths mid240 and near208 pixels; final heights mid100–145 and near65–90. Terrain and heroine will be added separately. Real RGBA transparency, no fake checkerboard, no cast drop shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines.
